== Strategy ==

This Profit deck suffers from a sever lack of aliens to keep Bo Shuda in play, hence the Someone Who Loves You.  Get Leia there fast and free HaM Salad, unless you manage to draw Lando or Shmi to keep Bo Shuda in play, in which case you can then play Order to Engage to make them lose lots until they move away, which frees Han, or you draw Leia and Someone Who Loves You, which frees Ham.  Then, carefully spread out and drain and make them lose force from the back of the objective, while at the same time retrieving with Tatooine Celebration and Lando, Scoundrel.  Anakin's Podracer is in to provide some protection against the race decks in my area.

Other cards that I would have liked to have included, well, include:

1. Ut-Oh!-added protection for Bo Shuda, three ways to keep the opponent from cancelling it.

2. Do Or Do Not&Wise; Advice-mainly to keep Order to Engage alive

3. The Camp-hinder the opponents deploying to Tatooine

4. Colo Claw Fish-help to ensure this deck gets the draws it needs to hit people, has a bit of a problem drawing low destiny

Please leave a comment about what I've included, and what I've thought about including, thanks.
